summary: Iteration 20 covered delivery backend + mobile-first frontend checks on public preview URL. Backend suite executed 21 tests (20 pass, 1 fail) for authz, provider ownership, city/radius enforcement, idempotent quote requests, Connect/payment gating, webhook secret guard, and payment split unit guards. Frontend mobile checks validated login, onboarding skip, Oggi->Delivery navigation, Roma city search, category/mode filters, payment-disabled notice, and admin-forbidden behavior for non-verified session.

critical.issue: Concurrent overlapping slot creation returns 500 instead of controlled 409. Root cause: create_slot catches DuplicateKeyError, but insert_many raises BulkWriteError(E11000 duplicate _id) on delivery_slot_locks conflicts.

integration_issues.issue: Direct URL navigation attempts to /delivery/provider from fresh page often land back on Oggi/home route before provider screen is mounted; deterministic testing worked only via Oggi -> Shop -> Il mio Delivery Chef path.

action_items: Fix slot overlap exception mapping in backend delivery.create_slot: handle pymongo BulkWriteError duplicate-key path and return HTTP 409 consistently.
After fix, retest concurrent slot create and downstream quote-reserve path under race conditions.

Run a dedicated admin Google-verified approval retest for full UI flow (approve provider -> customer quote request -> provider quote -> customer offer view), since admin Google session cannot be automated with shared test credentials.
Optionally harden provider route deep-link behavior for deterministic direct URL loading in Expo web preview.
critical_code_review_comments: delivery.py:create_slot currently catches DuplicateKeyError, but insert_many duplicate lock collisions emit BulkWriteError, causing unhandled 500s on overlap races.
Connect gating behaves correctly in this run: checkout/onboarding paths block with payment_config configured=false and webhook endpoint requires STRIPE_CONNECT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
Public provider catalogue response correctly excludes private provider fields and pending providers in tested path.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (core mobile delivery browse/filter + admin block checks passed; provider end-to-end/manage flows partially constrained by route/deep-link behavior and non-automatable admin Google session)

seed_data_creation: Created isolated ITER20 fixture users/providers/services/slots/bookings directly through API + temporary DB status mutation; cleanup fixture removed created users/sessions/providers/services/slots/bookings/reviews/uploads/file tokens.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-use /app/backend/tests/test_iter20_delivery_core.py and focus first on test_14 overlap race after backend fix. Keep using :visible selectors in Expo web runs and enter delivery provider screen via Oggi->Shop path for deterministic UI automation.
rca_of_issue: Repro for critical backend defect: for same provider/date/time/duration, submit POST /api/delivery/provider/slots twice in rapid sequence. Expected second response 409 overlap; observed 500. Backend log shows pymongo BulkWriteError E11000 on collection delivery_slot_locks (_id duplicate bucket). Since code only catches DuplicateKeyError, BulkWriteError bypasses graceful overlap handling. Mitigation: catch BulkWriteError (code 11000) and map to HTTP 409 with existing overlap message, plus cleanup of provisional slot locks.
